data.define: Someone who behaves with style and kindness.

example.text: Our coach is a real class act.

misuse.text: Don't say 'class act' about a school class.

data.l1_hook: Ổng cảm ơn mọi người, cả đối thủ!

native.tip: “class act” = Người lịch thiệp. Ví dụ: “Our coach is a real class act.”
